title: Context-Dependence, Perspective and Relativity
bookshelves: Category: Reference, Information and Interdisciplinary subjects
summary: This volume brings together original papers by linguists and philosophers on the role of context and perspective in language and thought. Several contributions are concerned with the contextualism/relativism debate, which has loomed large in recent philosophical discussions. In a substantial introduction, the editors survey the field and map out the relevant issues and positions.
